Every existing Control Panel trigger is re-homed onto its screen, the Control Panel becomes the index (scenario jumps, clock and reset stay there), and the HL7/FHIR tooling gets interim Future-scope badges plus an S1 caveat.

phases.title: AA fee as its own monthly invoice
phases.goal: Step 1, re-greened on its own: stop netting the 5% AA fee from the ACCPAY, so the payable equals the receivable and a part payment releases exactly the amount received (US-10.2.1); reseed billing history, remove the Xero simulator's fee block and web Payments' fee columns, and re-baseline the S3 figures. Each fee invoice has its own number, billing case and simulated ACCREC against the anaesthetist's Xero contact; it is always a separate invoice paid into AA's own account, never netted against payables (Greg, 2026-10-02: trust law). The BCTI count runs through one pure, tested function (BCTIs for an anaesthetist in a month), the only place the count is made. Later phases that add invoices (22, 36, 38b, 39, 39b) feed it and must keep it the only count. Admin and web Accounts show the fee invoice paid or unpaid, and Xero pair records carry the invoice number and reference. Pricing is one rule, with no step order or price-source record (the documents' order is not adopted): if the Procedure holds a price (a line's fixed price, the prepaid amount from 27, or one entered by someone permitted) that is the price, BTM kept for reference and optional (US-05.2.5, US-03.5.2); otherwise (B + T + M) x rate x (1 - discount), the rate the line's else the anaesthetist's own unit value (US-05.2.1; US-05.2.6: a fixed rate prices the whole Procedure, BTM required), the discount held as a fraction and shown as its own invoice line (US-05.4.3: 10% on $1,000 gives $900). A price of 0 or a 100% discount gives a no-charge invoice (invoiceBuild stops skipping zero groups); the version in force on the procedure date prices it; a submission is refused when no price can be worked out (no silent BTM fallback). Who may change them (FT-03.5, US-03.5.1, US-05.4.1, US-04.2.2; OQ-107, D50): where the Contract's editable setting allows, the anaesthetist changes price, rate or discount; where not, the price is read-only (no discount field on a fixed price, a fixed discount shown not editable) and they change the Contract or alert the office; the office changes any price, rate or discount on any Contract at any time (US-05.4.2, FT-05.4; OQ-16); no reason anywhere (priceOverride and its reason go, RV-04); every change audited and flagged at office review; the last change stands. The rate x time billing line, its rateTime basis and the Method 3 gate go (RV-03), the Aria hourly Contract re-expressed as a fixed-rate line; other billing lines stay until 39b. The anaesthetist sees the price and calculation (RV-29: the 2026-09-28 'no calculation' decision superseded where the catalogue shows a price; logged for Donald). A prepaid Procedure's price is 27's (D30). Keep it in one place in aa-prototype/src/domain/billing; link AR-28#how-a-procedure-is-priced and #price-reviews-and-controls, AR-29#contract-behaviour, #price-validation and #booking-procedure-fields, AR-30#booking-procedure.
phases.delivers: The price, rate and discount held on the Procedure: its price if held, else BTM x rate x (1 - discount), the discount its own invoice line, a no-charge invoice at $0, BTM optional on a fixed price, a submission refused when no price can be worked out. The anaesthetist changes them only where the Contract's editable flag allows; the office changes any; no reason, audited, flagged at review, last change stands. phases.title: Contract versions, staged changes and the AUTHORISED lock
phases.goal: (1) Staged Contract changes (DM-57, US-04.1.6, US-04.1.2's header-and-lines screen): edits to one Contract's header and lines are staged, not applied, and shown on a review dashboard for that Contract: header before and after, counts of lines added, altered, removed and unchanged, each altered line's changed values with blanks highlighted, errors that block submit (duplicate codes, a missing or past effective date, a second future-dated version) and warnings that do not (affected Bookings). The office sets the effective date and submits all or nothing, creating the new dated version (US-04.2.10; D45: never past or backdated, the previous version ending the day before, one future version at a time, correctable or withdrawable until it starts) and recording what changed (US-04.1.3: every version kept with its line diff and its invoices; nothing deleted). On submit, un-invoiced Procedures dated on or after the start relink to the new version's line with the same line key and refresh their values; unmatched ones are listed for the office; a prepaid Procedure keeps its invoiced price and is not relinked (OQ-104's default, D47). No upload (OQ-100, D34); 18's direct 'New version' becomes this flow. (2) The lock (DM-08): authoriseList writes a pricing snapshot per Procedure: Contract version and line, the values on the Procedure (units, price, rate, discount), the recorded BTM, the unit value in force (US-12.1.1), the price, the payer or billable party and the payee; no layers. The billing run prices only from it (US-08.1.1, RV-11): no effective-date fallback, no route resolution, no Resolve-and-retry that edits a master. Locked Bookings show 'Contract vN locked at authorise'. 'Regenerate from locked data' rebuilds an invoice exactly (US-08.4.4). The billing-failure trigger is re-based on a cause that survives the lock. US-07.3.1 and US-15.0.3 close here. Link AR-29#review-dashboard, #effective-dates, #future-dated-versions, #effect-on-bookings, #history, #pricing-snapshot, AR-30#contract and #booking-procedure.

phases.title: Prepayment lifecycle
phases.goal: Prepayment starts when the office picks, for any Procedure on the Booking, a Contract flagged prepaid (18's setting; D64), normally the anaesthetist's own price list (19a), checked across the whole Booking (US-06.2.1, FT-06.2, DM-20); the payer on the Booking (21) prepays, a person never an organisation (D23). Phase 20's interim is replaced: the deposit and split paths and prepaymentDetail go (RV-05). The prepaid amount is the price on that Contract's line, which always has one (OQ-92 answered, D27): full, never an estimate, deposit or part, shown to the anaesthetist on the Booking and where units are recorded (US-06.2.2, US-03.1.8). The prepayment invoice is generated when an admin approves it on an outgoing-invoices screen (US-06.3.1, FT-08.1; OQ-80 answered, D38; D6 superseded): pending prepayments listed 'Awaiting approval'; 'Approve and send' generates the invoice, its pair (a receivable from the payer and a payable to the prepay holding account, a minimal ledger payee and Xero contact the payables run never pays; 27a builds the account) and the draft Xero pair (US-09.1.3's shape), and sends it (letters are 41's); not invoiced again at submit. A prepaid Procedure keeps the price on its issued invoice through a Contract change (OQ-104's default, D47). At AUTHORISED it is priced at the prepaid amount, BTM for reference; the final invoice deducts the prepayment on a mixed Booking (OQ-116's default, D57), so nothing is left to bill; no balance invoice, no credit. Its price is locked (OQ-96's default, D30). Part-paid tracking; 15a's unpaid warning escalates mild to strong as the date nears, in both apps (US-06.3.2, D5). Re-check on a change of Procedures, Contract or payer before the procedure (US-06.3.5): cleared when no longer on a prepaid Contract, an unapproved one withdrawn, an approved one raising an office warning; a move is not a change. phases.title: Slot and List split
phases.goal: Introduce a Slot record for each active anaesthetist, day and session from the anaesthetist's start date (a new start-date field on the anaesthetist and the Add flow, editable afterwards), with a deterministic id, holding the availability status and default times. Per OQ-64 (answered), a Slot is a status container a List goes into, every Slot is stored across the horizon, and the status is the one mechanism the calendar edits (Phase 29), not a second record reconciled into Lists. Generation follows US-01.1.1 (Confirmed): every new Slot starts free (the RNG fill of private, public and unavailable sessions goes, including on rolled days and new anaesthetists), only active anaesthetists get Slots, then the anaesthetist's own calendar is painted, then the surgeons' recurring bookings (OQ-81 part 1, settled in the room; a recurring booking on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List in Phase 31). The horizon is a setting, four months in current practice (FT-01.1): shortening it drops far-edge days and extending it fills them. The List becomes its own record with a slotId, created on assignment: by office assignment from a free Slot (which requires a surgeon and a hospital, creates an ACTIVE List, the state 15b named, and shows Phase 17's not-preferred warning) or by the recurring-booking projection; once a List is in a Slot, the List shows in place of the status. The displayed status derives from the Slot plus the attached List, independent of bookings, and matches across mobile, web, admin and the availability finders (US-01.4.2), so a phone-booked session no longer reads Free. The admin availability finders list available anaesthetists through Phase 17's helper, ordered by priority tier and shuffled within a tier, with not-preferred pairings apart (US-01.3.5, US-01.3.6); the anaesthetists' own finders on mobile and web are never tier-ordered and show no preferences. The Admin Day grid's roster comes from the anaesthetist master, so added anaesthetists appear. Default AM and PM times and the horizon come from one schedule-settings record. Reassign moves a List between Slots, and the vacated Slot returns to free. Re-point the canvas generator, clock roll-forward, selectors, Admin Day grid, mobile schedule, web availability and registry context. The word 'slot' never reaches app copy (OQ-64): say session, AM or PM. Bump PERSIST_VERSION (15b already renamed the assigned List's state to ACTIVE).
phases.delivers: A Slot record for every active anaesthetist's session across a configurable horizon, free by default, holding availability and default times. A List with its own id, created on assignment and shown in place of the status. Status independent of bookings in all three apps and the finders, the admin finder ordered by tier with not-preferred pairings apart. Added anaesthetists on the Admin Day grid. Reassign moves a List between Slots
